name: Hearthwardens
description: Civic stewards who maintain Hearthwell viability, approve public works, and ring the brass crisis bell when a settlement starts slipping out of balance.

name: Ledger Houses
description: Archivists who track ancestry, contracts, property, and memory disputes. Their ledgers can restore a family name or quietly erase a lie from public life.
function: Lineage records, contracts, and memory governance

name: The Green Apron Guild
description: Farmers, cooks, brewers, fishers, and herbalists who treat food as civic magic. No festival, rescue convoy, or wedding feast happens without their apron seal.

name: Votive Smiths
description: Crafters who bind tools to vows, professions, family lines, and town history. A Votive Smith never asks what a blade is for only what promise will haunt it.

name: Wayfarer Compact
description: A loose adventurer network that maps rifts, escorts caravans, and reports topogenic anomalies before tavern rumors turn them into panic.

name: The Null Choir
description: A philosophical cult that believes names, borders, jobs, kinship, and desire are wounds in the world. They sing for everything to dissolve into the White Quiet.

name: Kinless Court
description: A political refuge for immigrants, orphans, exiles, unmarried residents, and players without local family ties. They bargain hard for people the old ledgers overlook.
function: Advocacy for the unaffiliated and immigrant rights
